blocks.text: Computational problems ko un ki characteristics (khoobiyan) aur unhein hal karne ke tareeqon ki base par alag alag qismon (categories) mein baanta ja sakta hai. Kuch aam qismein yeh hain:

items: Decision Problems: aise masle jin ka output sirf “haan” ya “nahi” hota hai. Misal: kya yeh number even (juft) hai?
Search Problems: aise masle jin mein koi hal ya cheez dhoondni hoti hai jo kuch criteria (shartein) poori kare. Misal: shehron ki list mein Islamabad dhoondna aur batana ke woh kis jagah par hai.
Optimization Problems: aise masle jin mein kisi criteria ke mutabiq sab se behtar hal dhoondna hota hai. Misal: tamam shehron se guzarne wala sab se chhota raasta.
Counting Problems: aise masle jin mein ginna hota hai ke kuch conditions (shartein) kitne tareeqon se poori ho sakti hain. Misal: tamam shehron se guzarne wale kitne raaste hain?

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Upar har qism ke saath di gayi misal hamari taraf se hai, kitab se nahi; yeh sirf farq samjhane ke liye hai.

blocks.prompt: Optimization problems ki nature (kis qisam ka hai) par baat kijiye aur asal zindagi ki misalein dijiye (long question 4).
blocks.explanation: Optimization masle ke kai sahi hal hote hain, aur woh kisi hisab se sab se behtar hal maangta hai, jaise kam se kam kharcha, sab se chhota faasla ya sab se zyada qeemat, aksar kuch constraints (hadon) ke saath. Misalein (is chapter se): sab se chhota delivery raasta (Travelling Salesman Problem), wazan ki had ke andar sab se qeemti saaman (Knapsack Problem), aur kam se kam sikkon mein raqam banana (Coin Change). Aise bohat se masle mushkil hote hain, is liye greedy tareeqe ya dynamic programming istemal hoti hai.

items: Maslon ki qismein: decision (haan/nahi), search (dhoondna), optimization (sab se behtar), counting (kitne tareeqe).
